sentences.zh: 志伊獲譴，紹蘭坐不能匡正，牽連罷職。

translations.literal: Zhiyi received punishment; Shaolan was punished for failing to correct matters and was dismissed by implication.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhiyi was punished. Shaolan was censured for failing to set matters right and was dismissed by implication.

sentences.zh: 少嗜學，究經史大義。

translations.literal: In youth he was devoted to learning and investigated the great principles of the classics and histories.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he loved learning and pursued the great principles of the classics and histories.

sentences.zh: 去官後，一意著述，以許慎、鄭康成為宗，於儀禮、說文致力尤深，著書皆可傳。

translations.literal: After leaving office he devoted himself entirely to writing, taking Xu Shen and Zheng Xuan as his models; he especially applied himself to the Ceremonies and the Shuowen, and his books are all worth transmitting.
translations.idiomatic: After leaving office he devoted himself entirely to scholarship, taking Xu Shen and Zheng Xuan as his models. He applied himself especially to the Ceremonies and the Shuowen, and his writings are all works of lasting value.

sentences.zh: 李奕疇，字書年，河南夏邑人。

translations.literal: Li Yichou, styled Shunian, was a native of Xiayi in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yichou, styled Shunian, was a native of Xiayi in Henan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十五年進士，選庶吉士，授檢討。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year of Qianlong he became a jinshi, was selected as bachelor of the Hanlin Academy, and appointed reviser.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fifth year of Qianlong he passed the metropolitan examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and appointed reviser.

sentences.zh: 大考改禮部主事，典貴州鄉試，洊遷郎中。

translations.literal: In the ranking examination he was transferred to a secretary in the Ministry of Rites, conducted the Guizhou provincial examinations, and rose in succession to bureau director.
translations.idiomatic: In the Hanlin ranking examination he was transferred to a secretary in the Ministry of Rites, served as chief examiner for the Guizhou provincial examinations, and rose in succession to bureau director.

sentences.zh: 五十七年，出為山西寧武知府，調平陽，有政聲。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year he went out as prefect of Ningwu in Shanxi, was transferred to Pingyang, and won a reputation for good governance.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-seventh year he was appointed prefect of Ningwu in Shanxi, later transferred to Pingyang, and earned a reputation for effective governance.

sentences.zh: 歷江蘇糧道、山東按察使。

translations.literal: He served as Jiangsu grain intendant and Shandong provincial judge in succession.
translations.idiomatic: He served in succession as Jiangsu grain intendant and Shandong provincial judge.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十一年，坐巡撫保薦屬吏違例，牽連被議，左遷江南河庫道。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Jiaqing he was censured because a governor's recommendation of a subordinate violated regulations; implicated by connection he was demoted to Jiangnan river-treasury intendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Jiaqing he was censured because a governor's recommendation of a subordinate had violated regulations. Implicated in the affair, he was demoted to Jiangnan river-treasury intendant.

sentences.zh: 十三年，遷安徽按察使，治獄明慎，多平反。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was transferred to Anhui provincial judge; he handled cases with clarity and caution and reversed many wrongful convictions.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was transferred to Anhui provincial judge. He handled cases with clarity and care and reversed many wrongful convictions.

sentences.zh: 霍丘民範受之者，贅於顧氏，與妻反目，外出久不歸。

translations.literal: A Huoqiu commoner named Fan Shouzhi had married into the Gu family as a son-in-law; he and his wife were estranged and went away for a long time without returning.
translations.idiomatic: A Huoqiu man named Fan Shouzhi had married into the Gu family as a son-in-law. He and his wife quarreled, and he left home for a long time without returning.

sentences.zh: 縣令誤聽訛言，謂其妻私於鄰楊三，鍛鍊成獄，當顧氏、楊三謀殺罪，其母與弟及傭工某加功，實無左證，五人者不勝刑，皆誣服。

translations.literal: The county magistrate mistakenly believed rumors that his wife had illicit relations with the neighbor Yang San; the case was forged into a conviction of the Gu woman and Yang San for plotting murder, with her mother, brother, and a hired laborer named as accomplices; in truth there was no corroborating evidence; the five could not endure torture and all confessed falsely.
translations.idiomatic: The county magistrate believed false rumors that Fan's wife had been intimate with a neighbor named Yang San. The case was tortured into shape, and the Gu woman, Yang San, her mother, her brother, and a hired laborer were all convicted of plotting Fan's murder as accomplices. There was in fact no corroborating evidence, but the five could not endure the torture and all confessed falsely.

sentences.zh: 奕疇閱供詞，疑之，驟詰曰：「爾曹言骨已被焚，然尚有臟腑腸胃，棄之何所？」

translations.literal: Yichou read the depositions, grew suspicious, and suddenly demanded: "You say the bones were already burned—yet there would still be organs and bowels; where did you discard them?"
translations.idiomatic: Yichou read the depositions, grew suspicious, and suddenly demanded, "You say the bones were burned. Yet there would still be organs and entrails—where did you dispose of them?"

sentences.zh: 囚不能對，惟伏地哭。

translations.literal: The prisoners could not answer and only wept prostrate on the ground.
translations.idiomatic: The prisoners could not answer and only wept prostrate on the ground.

sentences.zh: 奕疇慨然曰：「是有冤！」

translations.literal: Yichou said in indignation: "There is injustice here!"
translations.idiomatic: Yichou said in indignation, "This is a case of injustice!"

sentences.zh: 使幹吏偵之，至陳姓家，言正月十五夜受之曾過宿，而讞曰被殺在十三日，乃緩系諸囚，嚴緝受之。

translations.literal: He sent capable officers to investigate; at a Chen household it was learned that on the night of the fifteenth of the first month Shouzhi had stayed there, while the verdict said he was killed on the thirteenth; he then relaxed the detention of the prisoners and strictly hunted for Shouzhi.
translations.idiomatic: He sent capable officers to investigate. At a household surnamed Chen they learned that on the night of the fifteenth of the first month Fan Shouzhi had stayed there, while the verdict held that he had been killed on the thirteenth. He then eased the prisoners' confinement and ordered a strict search for Fan Shouzhi.

sentences.zh: 久之，受之忽自歸，則以負博遠避，不敢使家人知所在，今始聞大獄起，乃歸投案也。

translations.literal: After a long time Shouzhi suddenly returned on his own; he had fled far to escape gambling debts and dared not let his family know where he was; only now hearing that a major case had arisen did he return to give himself up.
translations.idiomatic: After a long while Fan Shouzhi suddenly returned on his own. He had fled far away to escape gambling debts and had not dared let his family know where he was. Only now, hearing that a major case had arisen, did he come back to give himself up.

sentences.zh: 事得白。

translations.literal: The matter was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: The truth came to light and the case was cleared.

sentences.zh: 奕疇故無子，獄既解，乃生子銘皖。

translations.literal: Yichou had formerly been without a son; once the case was resolved he then had a son named Mingwan.
translations.idiomatic: Yichou had long been childless. Once the case was resolved, he then had a son named Mingwan.

sentences.zh: 民間傳頌，至演為劇曲。

translations.literal: The people spread the tale in praise, even performing it as opera.
translations.idiomatic: The story spread among the people in praise of him, and was even adapted into opera.

sentences.zh: 就遷布政使。

translations.literal: He was promoted in place to provincial administration commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted in place to provincial administration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十八年，擢浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was promoted to be Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he was promoted to governor of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 時近畿教匪未靖，或言嚴、衢兩郡匪徒傳習天罡會，詔奕疇嚴治。

translations.literal: At the time sect rebels in the metropolitan periphery were not yet pacified; some said that in the two prefectures of Yan and Qu bandits were transmitting and practicing the Tiangan Society; an edict ordered Yichou to deal with them strictly.
translations.idiomatic: Sect rebels in the metropolitan periphery had not yet been pacified. Some reported that bandits in Yan and Qu prefectures were practicing the Tiangan Society. The throne ordered Yichou to investigate strictly.

sentences.zh: 奕疇逮訊葉機、姚漢楫等，實止愚民相聚誦經祈福，無逆跡，坐罪首犯數人，株連皆省釋。

translations.literal: Yichou arrested and interrogated Ye Ji, Yao Hanji, and others; in truth it was only foolish commoners gathered to chant sutras and pray for blessings, with no signs of rebellion; he convicted a few chief offenders and had all those implicated by association released.
translations.idiomatic: Yichou arrested and questioned Ye Ji, Yao Hanji, and others. In truth they were only simple folk gathered to chant sutras and pray for blessings, with no trace of sedition. He convicted only a few ringleaders and released everyone else caught up in the case.

sentences.zh: 安徽、江西遊民來浙租山墾種者日眾，言官請禁。

translations.literal: Wandering people from Anhui and Jiangxi who came to Zhejiang to rent mountains for reclamation and planting grew daily more numerous; censors requested a ban.
translations.idiomatic: An ever-growing number of vagabonds from Anhui and Jiangxi were coming to Zhejiang to lease hillsides for reclamation and farming. Censors asked that they be barred.

sentences.zh: 奕疇疏陳勢難遽逐，請分年遣令回籍。

translations.literal: Yichou memorialized that the situation made sudden expulsion difficult and requested that they be sent back to their native places over successive years.
translations.idiomatic: Yichou memorialized that sudden expulsion was impractical and asked that they be sent home in stages over several years.

sentences.zh: 上悟曰：「茲事不易言。

translations.literal: The Emperor came to understand and said: "This matter is not easy to speak of.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor understood the difficulty and said, "This is not a simple matter.

sentences.zh: 遊民皆無恆產，驅之此省，又轉徙他省，斷不能復歸鄉里。」

translations.literal: Wandering people all lack fixed property; drive them from this province and they will move on to another, and can by no means return to their home districts."
translations.idiomatic: These wanderers have no fixed livelihood. Drive them from one province and they will drift to another; they cannot possibly make their way home."

sentences.zh: 命徐謀教養，俾流亡者變為土著，乃得安。

translations.literal: He ordered that they be slowly provided education and support, so that exiles might become settled natives—only then could there be peace.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered a gradual policy of settlement and support so that uprooted people might become permanent residents. Only then could the region be at peace.

sentences.zh: 尋授漕運總督，在任五年，運務無誤。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed grain-transport director-general; in five years in office the transport duties were without error.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed director-general of the grain transport. In five years in office he kept transport affairs running without a hitch.

sentences.zh: 奕疇固長者，待下寬，坐濫委運弁降四級，命以吏、禮二部郎中用。

translations.literal: Yichou was by nature a tolerant elder; he treated subordinates leniently; for indiscriminately delegating to transport officers he was demoted four ranks and ordered to serve as a department director in the Ministries of Personnel and Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Yichou was by nature mild and treated his subordinates leniently. Because he had delegated transport duties too freely, he was demoted four ranks and assigned as a director in the Ministries of Personnel and Rites.

sentences.zh: 復以運弁縱容幫丁索費，被劾，降主事。

translations.literal: Again, because transport officers indulged transport laborers in demanding fees, he was impeached and demoted to secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He was impeached again when transport officers allowed boat hands to extort fees, and was demoted to secretary.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，宣宗即位，命奕疇以尚書守護昌陵。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, when the Xuanzong Emperor acceded, Yichou was ordered to guard Changling with the rank of minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, when the Xuanzong Emperor acceded to the throne, Yichou was ordered to guard the Chang Mausoleum with ministerial rank.

sentences.zh: 道光二年，原品休致。

translations.literal: In the second year of Daoguang he retired at his original rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Daoguang reign he retired at his original rank.

sentences.zh: 十九年，重宴鹿鳴，加太子少保。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he was again feasted at the Luming banquet and granted Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he was again honored at the Luming banquet and made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 明年，會榜重逢，子銘皖適登第，同與恩榮宴，稱盛事焉。

translations.literal: The next year the metropolitan lists were reunited; his son Mingwan happened to pass the examinations; father and son together attended the imperial grace banquet—it was called a grand occasion.
translations.idiomatic: The following year father and son both appeared on the metropolitan lists when his son Mingwan passed the examinations. They attended the imperial grace banquet together, which was hailed as a singular honor.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，卒，年九十有一。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he died, aged ninety-one.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he died, at the age of ninety-one.

sentences.zh: 錢楷，字裴山，浙江嘉興人。

translations.literal: Qian Kai, styled Peishan, was a native of Jiaxing in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Kai, styled Peishan, was a native of Jiaxing in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十四年進士，選翰林院庶吉士，散館改戶部主事，充軍機章京。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year of Qianlong he became a metropolitan graduate, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and after leaving the Hanlin academy was made a secretary in the Ministry of Revenue and served as a Grand Council clerical secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year of Qianlong he passed the metropolitan examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and after leaving the academy was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Revenue and served as a Grand Council clerical secretary.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶三年，典四川鄉試，督廣西學政，回京，仍直軍機。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiaqing he served as director of the Sichuan provincial examinations, supervised education in Guangxi, returned to the capital, and still attended at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jiaqing he directed the Sichuan provincial examinations, served as Guangxi education intendant, returned to the capital, and still worked at the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 遷禮部郎中，調刑部，甚被眷遇。

translations.literal: He was promoted to director in the Ministry of Rites, transferred to the Ministry of Justice, and was greatly favored.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to director in the Ministry of Rites, transferred to the Ministry of Justice, and enjoyed exceptional imperial favor.

sentences.zh: 截取京察當外用，予升銜留任。

translations.literal: At the Beijing evaluation for transfer to outside appointment he was given a promotion in rank and kept at his post.
translations.idiomatic: At the Beijing evaluation he was slated for an outside appointment, but was granted a promotion in rank and kept at his post.

sentences.zh: 十一年，詔嘉楷久直勤勉，以四五品京堂用。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year an edict praised Kai's long service and diligence and ordered him used as a capital official of the fourth or fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year an edict praised Kai's long and diligent service at court and appointed him to a capital post of the fourth or fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 歷太常寺少卿、光祿寺卿。

translations.literal: He served as Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 十二年，京師旱，疏請循漢書求雨閉陽縱陰之說，停止正陽門外石路工程，詔「修省在實政，無事傅會五行」，罷其奏。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the capital suffered drought; he memorialized following the Han History's theory of seeking rain by closing yang and releasing yin, and requested halting the stone road project outside Zhengyang Gate. An edict said: "Self-examination lies in real governance; there is no need to force conformity with the Five Phases," and his memorial was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year the capital suffered drought. He memorialized citing the Han History's theory of seeking rain by restraining yang and releasing yin, and asked that work on the stone road outside Zhengyang Gate be halted. The throne replied, "Self-examination lies in real governance; there is no need to force conformity with the Five Phases," and his memorial was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 迭命往河南、山西鞫獄，次第奏結，無枉縱。

translations.literal: Repeatedly ordered to investigate cases in Henan and Shanxi, he reported conclusions in turn without wrongfully condemning or releasing.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly sent to try cases in Henan and Shanxi, reported his findings in turn, and neither wrongfully convicted nor improperly released anyone.

sentences.zh: 授河南布政使，十四年，護理巡撫，暫署河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Appointed Henan provincial administration commissioner; in the fourteenth year he acted as governor, and temporarily served as director-general of the Eastern Henan waterways.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Henan provincial administration commissioner. In the fourteenth year he acted as governor and temporarily served as director-general of the Eastern Henan waterways.

sentences.zh: 擢授廣西巡撫，尋調湖北。

translations.literal: Promoted and appointed Guangxi governor; soon transferred to Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted and appointed governor of Guangxi, and soon transferred to Hubei.

sentences.zh: 十六年，疏言：「外洋鴉片煙入中國，奸商巧為夾帶。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he memorialized: "Foreign opium enters China; crafty merchants ingeniously smuggle it in concealed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he memorialized: "Foreign opium is entering China, and crafty merchants smuggle it in by ingenious concealment.

sentences.zh: 凡粵東西兩省匪類糾結，多由於此，以致盜風益熾。

translations.literal: All bandit gangs in the two provinces of eastern and western Yue (Guangdong and Guangxi) are largely linked through this, causing the tide of banditry to grow fiercer.
translations.idiomatic: Bandit gangs in Guangdong and Guangxi are largely organized through this trade, and banditry has grown fiercer as a result.

sentences.zh: 請飭閩、粵各關監督並近海督撫，嚴督關員盤檢，按律加等究辦。

translations.literal: He requested that the customs supervisors of Fujian and Guangdong and the coastal governors and governors-general be strictly ordered to supervise customs officers in thorough inspection and to punish according to law with increased severity.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that the customs supervisors of Fujian and Guangdong and the coastal governors and governors-general strictly supervise customs officers in thorough inspection and punish offenders under the law with increased severity.

sentences.zh: 內地貨賣一經發覺，窮究買自何人，來從何處，不得含糊搪塞，將失察偷漏監督委員及地方官一體參處，務使來踪盡絕，流弊自除，乃清理匪源之一端也。」

translations.literal: Once sales inland were discovered, trace who bought from whom and whence it came; no evasive answers permitted; supervisors, commissioners, and local officials who failed to detect smuggling were all to be impeached together; strive to cut off the source entirely so abuses cease by themselves—this is one means of clearing the roots of banditry."
translations.idiomatic: Whenever inland sales were discovered, buyers were to be traced to their source without evasion or prevarication. Supervisors, commissioners, and local officials who failed to detect smuggling were all to be impeached together. Only by cutting off the supply entirely could the abuse be ended—this, he argued, was one way to strike at the roots of banditry."

sentences.zh: 詔下沿海督撫認真察辦。

translations.literal: An edict was sent to coastal governors and governors-general to investigate and handle conscientiously.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was sent to coastal governors and governors-general to investigate and enforce the policy conscientiously.

sentences.zh: 授戶部侍郎，兼管錢法堂事。

translations.literal: Appointed Vice Minister of Revenue and concurrently directed the Currency Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Vice Minister of Revenue and concurrently directed the Currency Bureau.

sentences.zh: 奏陳湖北地方事宜應酌劑者四端：請附近荊州糧米供支滿營兵食，餘俱改歸北漕；

translations.literal: He memorialized on four points in Hubei local affairs requiring adjustment: request that grain from nearby Jingzhou supply Manchu garrison rations, with the remainder transferred to northern transport;
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized on four points in Hubei affairs that required adjustment: grain from nearby Jingzhou should supply Manchu garrison rations, with the remainder transferred to the northern transport system;

sentences.zh: 沿江契買洲地，准其耕種納糧，無契者作為官地，召佃承種；

translations.literal: Along the river, land on sandbars purchased by contract might be cultivated and taxed; where there was no contract treat it as government land and lease to tenant farmers;
translations.idiomatic: along the river, sandbar land purchased by contract should be allowed to be farmed and taxed; where no contract existed it should be treated as government land and leased to tenant farmers;

sentences.zh: 新設提督，移駐襄陽府城；

translations.literal: The newly established provincial military commander should be moved to Xiangyang prefectural city;
translations.idiomatic: the newly established provincial military commander should be stationed in Xiangyang prefectural city;

sentences.zh: 楚北均食淮鹽，襄陽、宜昌等府籌議減價。

translations.literal: Northern Hubei all used Huai salt; Xiangyang, Yichang, and other prefectures were to consider price reductions.
translations.idiomatic: northern Hubei all consumed Huai salt, and Xiangyang, Yichang, and other prefectures should consider lowering prices.

sentences.zh: 下所司會議，惟沿江洲地一事照行，餘以窒礙置之。

translations.literal: The matter was referred for joint deliberation; only the sandbar land proposal was carried out, the rest set aside as impracticable.
translations.idiomatic: The proposals were referred for joint deliberation. Only the sandbar land measure was adopted; the rest were set aside as impracticable.

sentences.zh: 復出署河南巡撫。

translations.literal: Again he went out to serve as acting Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: He was again sent out to serve as acting governor of Henan.

sentences.zh: 匪徒王胯子句結南陽饑民滋事，成大獄。

translations.literal: The bandit Wang Kuazi colluded with hungry people of Nanyang to make trouble, becoming a major case.
translations.idiomatic: The outlaw Wang Kuazi incited hungry peasants in Nanyang to rise in disorder, and the affair grew into a major criminal case.

sentences.zh: 楷至任，疏言：「前任巡撫恩長於南陽匪徒一案，前後具奏情節與原報不符，辦理過當。

translations.literal: When Kai took office, he memorialized: "The former governor En Chang in the Nanyang bandit case—the circumstances reported in his memorials before and after did not match the original reports, and he handled it excessively.
translations.idiomatic: When Kai took up his post, he memorialized: "In the Nanyang bandit case, my predecessor En Chang reported circumstances in his successive memorials that did not match the original reports, and he handled the matter with excessive severity.

sentences.zh: 府、州、縣等緝犯並未廢弛，平日聲名尚好，現擬絞監候之二十餘犯，明年秋審，均應情實，不敢知而不言。」

translations.literal: At the prefectures, departments, and counties pursuit of criminals had not been neglected; ordinarily their reputation was still good. The more than twenty offenders now proposed for strangulation with imprisonment awaiting execution, at next year's autumn review, should all be confirmed for execution—I dare not know this and not speak."
translations.idiomatic: The prefectural, department, and county officials had not slackened in hunting down offenders, and their reputations had ordinarily been good. Yet the more than twenty men now proposed for strangulation pending the autumn review should all be confirmed for execution at next year's review—I cannot know this and remain silent."

sentences.zh: 詔以「句決與否，臨時自有權衡，非臣下所可豫定。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Whether to order immediate execution or not, at the moment the court will weigh matters itself; this is not something subordinates may decide in advance.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor replied: "Whether to order immediate execution is a matter the court will weigh when the time comes; subordinates are not entitled to decide it in advance.

sentences.zh: 地方官咎有應得，豈能開復？」

translations.literal: The local officials' fault is what they deserve—how can they be rehabilitated?"
translations.idiomatic: The local officials deserve the blame they bear—how can they be restored to favor?"

sentences.zh: 斥楷敷陳未當，近於喜事。

translations.literal: Kai was rebuked for presenting his case improperly, nearly akin to stirring up trouble.
translations.idiomatic: Kai was rebuked for impropriety in his memorial and for coming close to meddlesome zeal.

sentences.zh: 調補工部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to fill the post of Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred and appointed vice minister of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 尋授安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: Soon thereafter he was appointed Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was appointed governor of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 以歙縣監生張良璧採生斃命，命楷親訊，讞擬未依凌遲律，失於輕比，部議降一級調用，改降二級留任。

translations.literal: Because the She County student licentiate Zhang Liangbi had caused death by collecting from the living, Kai was ordered to examine the case personally; the proposed verdict did not follow the lingchi statute and was too lenient in comparison. The ministry deliberated demotion by one rank and transfer; it was changed to demotion by two ranks with retention in office.
translations.idiomatic: When the She County student licentiate Zhang Liangbi was convicted of causing death in the crime of harvesting from living victims, Kai was ordered to conduct the inquiry in person. His proposed sentence failed to apply the statute for death by slicing and was unduly lenient; the Ministry deliberated demoting him one rank and transferring him, but this was revised to a two-rank demotion with retention in office.

sentences.zh: 十七年，卒。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he died.

sentences.zh: 詔以「楷直樞曹久，有勞，自簡封圻，治理安靜。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Kai served long in the Grand Council secretariat with merit; since he was selected for a frontier post, his governance has been tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Kai has long served diligently in the Grand Council and earned merit; since he was appointed to a provincial post, his rule has been calm and orderly.

sentences.zh: 母程年逾七旬，嗣子尚幼，深憫之，特賜卹。」

translations.literal: His mother Cheng was over seventy; his heir son was still young. The court deeply pitied them and specially granted condolence payments."
translations.idiomatic: His mother Cheng was more than seventy years old, and his heir was still a child. Deeply moved, the court granted special condolence payments."

sentences.zh: 和舜武，伊拉里氏，滿洲鑲藍旗人。

translations.literal: He Shunwu, of the Ilari clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He Shunwu, of the Ilari clan, was a Manchu bannerman of the Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 官學生，考授太常寺筆帖式。

translations.literal: A student of the Imperial College, by examination he received appointment as a copyist in the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: He was an Imperial College student and, through examination, received appointment as a copyist in the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 累遷步軍統領衙門員外郎。

translations.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to an outside secretary in the Metropolitan Infantry Command.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in succession to outside secretary in the Metropolitan Infantry Command.

sentences.zh: 以治獄明獲議敘，遷兵部郎中，兼公中佐領。

translations.literal: For clarity in handling cases he received merit citation; he was promoted to director in the Ministry of War and concurrently served as garrison assistant commandant.
translations.idiomatic: For his skill in adjudicating cases he received merit citation, was promoted to director in the Ministry of War, and concurrently held a garrison assistant commandant's post.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十五年，出為江蘇鹽法道。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Jiaqing he went out as Jiangsu salt-control intendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Jiaqing he was appointed Jiangsu intendant for salt administration.

sentences.zh: 累遷山東布政使，整飭吏治，輿論歸之。

translations.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to Shandong provincial administration commissioner, rectified official discipline, and public opinion rallied to him.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted in succession to provincial administration commissioner of Shandong, where he tightened official discipline and won widespread praise.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，擢山西巡撫，調河南。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was promoted to Shanxi governor and transferred to Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he was promoted to governor of Shanxi and then transferred to Henan.

sentences.zh: 會布政使吳邦慶疏請於漳、衛合流之處建閘壩，和舜武謂：「漳河盛漲湍悍，非一閘所能禦，越閘旁趨，且停蓄泥沙，塞衛水宣洩之路。」

translations.literal: When provincial administration commissioner Wu Bangqing memorialized to build a sluice at the confluence of the Zhang and Wei rivers, He Shunwu said: "When the Zhang River swells it is swift and fierce; one sluice cannot hold it back. Water will rush past the sluice on either side and also trap silt, blocking the Wei River's path for discharge."
translations.idiomatic: When the provincial administration commissioner Wu Bangqing memorialized to build a sluice dam where the Zhang and Wei rivers join, He Shunwu argued: "When the Zhang swells, its current is swift and fierce—no single gate can contain it. Water will spill around the gate and silt will accumulate, choking the Wei River's outlet."

sentences.zh: 疏請罷之，仍舊章每年挑濬竇公河以資鹽運，如所議行。

translations.literal: He memorialized to abolish the project and follow the old rule of dredging the Dougong River each year to support salt transport, and this was carried out as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to abandon the project and maintain the established practice of annual dredging of the Dougong River to sustain salt transport; the proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 逾年，調山東。

translations.literal: After a year he was transferred to Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: A year later he was transferred to Shandong.

sentences.zh: 仁宗聞其前為布政使有聲，故有此授。

translations.literal: Emperor Renzong heard that he had earlier made a name as provincial administration commissioner, and therefore gave him this appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Renzong had heard of his reputation when he had served as provincial administration commissioner, and for that reason appointed him again.

sentences.zh: 山東民俗好訟，又近畿，輒走訴京師。

translations.literal: Shandong folk custom favored litigation; being also near the capital, people often ran to plead in Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong custom was litigious, and because the province lay close to the capital, people often rushed to file appeals in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 和舜武再蒞，訟頓減，特詔褒勉。

translations.literal: When He Shunwu took office again, lawsuits abruptly diminished, and a special edict praised and encouraged him.
translations.idiomatic: When He Shunwu returned to office, lawsuits fell sharply, and the court issued a special edict of commendation.

sentences.zh: 疏請清理京控積案，責巡撫、籓、臬分提鞫訊，月定課程，各自陳奏；

translations.literal: He memorialized to clear accumulated capital-appeal cases, charging the governor, provincial treasurer, and provincial judge each to take up interrogation, set monthly quotas, and report separately.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to clear the backlog of capital appeals, directing the governor, treasurer, and provincial judge each to conduct interrogations, setting monthly quotas for which each was to report separately to the throne.

sentences.zh: 又請酌​​改竊盜窩匪條例，加重定擬，俟盜風稍戢，復舊：並從之。

translations.literal: He also asked to revise provisionally the regulations on theft and harboring bandits, increasing the proposed penalties, to revert to the old rules when banditry eased slightly—all was approved.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked to revise temporarily the statutes on theft and harborers of bandits with heavier sentences, to be restored when robbery abated—all was approved.

sentences.zh: 至年終，審結積案千餘起，予優敘。

translations.literal: By year's end, more than a thousand accumulated cases were tried and closed; he was granted preferential citation.
translations.idiomatic: By year's end more than a thousand backlog cases had been concluded, and he received preferential merit citation.

sentences.zh: 京察复予議敘。

translations.literal: At the capital performance review he again received merit citation.
translations.idiomatic: At the metropolitan performance review he again received merit citation.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，卒，上甚惜之，優詔賜卹，贈總督銜，諡恭慎。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he died; the sovereign deeply regretted it, granted excellent edict condolence payments, posthumously gave him the rank of governor-general, and bestowed on him the posthumous title Gongjin.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he died. The Emperor grieved deeply, granted lavish condolence by edict, posthumously invested him with governor-general rank, and gave him the posthumous title Gongjin.

sentences.zh: 論曰：仁宗初政，特重廉吏。

translations.literal: Commentary says: At the start of Renzong's rule, incorrupt officials were especially valued.
translations.idiomatic: The commentators say: At the beginning of Emperor Renzong's reign, incorrupt officials were especially prized.

sentences.zh: 岳起、荊道乾清操實政為之冠；

translations.literal: Yue Qi and Jing Daoqian, with upright conduct and solid administration, stood at the head.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Qi and Jing Daoqian, with their upright conduct and solid administration, stood foremost among them.

sentences.zh: 謝啟昆、張師誠才猷建樹，卓越一時：並專圻碩望矣。

translations.literal: Xie Qikun and Zhang Shicheng, with talent and achievements, stood out for a generation—all were great figures among frontier governors.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Qikun and Zhang Shicheng, with talent and accomplishment, rose above their contemporaries: all were commanding figures among provincial governors.

sentences.zh: 李殿圖、李奕疇、錢楷亦各以明慎慈惠見稱，和舜武課最簿書，遂邀易名曠典；

translations.literal: Li Diantu, Li Yichou, and Qian Kai were also each famed for clarity, caution, and kindness; He Shunwu excelled in administrative records and so received exceptional posthumous honors.
translations.idiomatic: Li Diantu, Li Yichou, and Qian Kai were likewise praised for prudent clarity and kindly rule; He Shunwu, through excellence in administrative work, won rare posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 王紹蘭一眚坐廢，晚成經學：殆有幸有不幸哉？

translations.literal: Wang Shaolan, for one fault, was dismissed; he later mastered classical learning—is it not perhaps fortune mixed with misfortune?
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shaolan was cast down for a single fault, yet in later years mastered the classical learning: was it not a life in which fortune and misfortune were strangely mingled?
